title: Copied but not yet separated
hook: Predict the result, then reveal the sequence.

knows: DNA and RNA are sequences of chemical building blocks.
doesNotKnow: Each chromosome is copied into two sister chromatids joined at a centromere. Before separation, this model has two chromosomes and four chromatids; each X stands for a duplicated chromosome.

misconception: The original sequence and the resulting sequence must have the same interpretation.
objective: Each chromosome is copied into two sister chromatids joined at a centromere. Before separation, this model has two chromosomes and four chromatids; each X stands for a duplicated chromosome.

claims.text: Question, answer, diagram and explanation: A cell has two unreplicated chromosomes. After DNA replication, before sister chromatids separate, how many chromosomes and chromatids are there? Each chromosome is copied into two sister chromatids joined at a centromere. Before separation, this model has two chromosomes and four chromatids; each X stands for a duplicated chromosome.
Recall: After DNA replication and before chromatid separation, how many sister chromatids are in one duplicated chromosome? A duplicated chromosome has two sister chromatids before they separate.
The figure is a simplified model and is not to scale.

recall.question: After DNA replication and before chromatid separation, how many sister chromatids are in one duplicated chromosome?
recall.why: A duplicated chromosome has two sister chromatids before they separate.
